description: This file defines the FilterClassAdapter class, which extends ASM's ClassVisitor to filter out class members (fields, methods, inner classes) based on access modifiers and custom filter criteria.

classes.name: FilterClassAdapter
classes.description: A class visitor that filters out private, default-access, or rejected class members (fields, methods, inner classes) based on specified filter criteria.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Sets the class name and delegates to superclass visit method.

methods.name: visitEnd
methods.description: Finalizes the visit, delegates to superclass.

methods.name: visitField
methods.description: Filters fields based on access modifiers and custom filter acceptance; returns null to skip or delegates to superclass.

methods.name: visitMethod
methods.description: Filters methods based on access modifiers and custom filter acceptance for both descriptor and signature; returns null to skip or delegates to superclass.

methods.name: visitAnnotation
methods.description: Handles annotations; currently passes through without filtering.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Handles class attributes; currently does nothing.

methods.name: visitInnerClass
methods.description: Filters inner classes based on access modifiers and custom filter acceptance.

methods.name: visitOuterClass
methods.description: Handles outer class info; currently passes through.

methods.name: visitSource
methods.description: Handles source info; currently passes through.
